audit.whatIsWrong: Seven fields attribute Mel's reflect to her ultimate — 'her R can reflect the burst right back', 'time her R to bounce a committed Rupture-burst', 'reflects your engage with R', 'Hold her R to reflect'. The reflect is Rebuttal (W). Golden Eclipse (R) does something completely different: it strikes every enemy carrying Overwhelm stacks regardless of distance. Three more fields claim Radiant Volley pokes 'from outside Rupture's cast range'; both abilities are 950.
audit.why: Both errors point the player at the wrong button at the wrong time. A Cho'Gath waiting for Mel to burn her ultimate before committing will wait forever — the save he needs to bait is Rebuttal, 38 seconds at rank 1 and free of mana cost at rank 5, and it does not merely reflect projectiles, it prevents her taking damage at all. Meanwhile the ability he is told is a counter-engage tool is in fact a global execute finisher off Searing Brilliance's Overwhelm stacks, which means walking away chipped is not safe. And believing he is out-ranged makes him concede a range war he is not losing: Rupture reaches exactly as far as Radiant Volley. What he actually loses is the cast — hers lands immediately, his is a telegraphed delayed circle.
audit.corrected: Move every reflect reference to Rebuttal with its 38s cooldown, describe Golden Eclipse as a 120s global Overwhelm strike, and replace the range claim with the real asymmetry (equal 950 reach, instant versus delayed).

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers score Level 2 as Skill, Levels 3 and 4-5 as Cho'Gath, Level 6 as Mel and 2+ items as Cho'Gath. The packet chart says Mel through Level 3, Skill at 4-5, Cho'Gath at 6 and first item, Mel at 2+ items — and the content whys already say precisely that on every row.
audit.why: The whys read 'Levels 2-3 are your most abusable window' (currently scored Skill and Cho'Gath), 'farm the lane even' at 4-5 (currently Cho'Gath), 'she dies through her resists' at 6 (currently Mel) and 'Full-AP Mel reclaims it late' (currently Cho'Gath). Five of seven rows are scored against their own explanation on a 50.69% lane. diffRating 7.5/10 and the orange tone also do not match a 50.69% matchup over 363 games or the diff token EVEN sitting beside them.
audit.corrected: Chart becomes Mel, Mel, Mel, Skill, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Mel with ratings 3, 3, 3, 5, 6, 6, 3; diffRating 5/10; tone the EVEN yellow.

audit.whatIsWrong: Solar Snare is named as the tracked cooldown in a dozen fields with no number, and neither Rebuttal nor Golden Eclipse is given one anywhere.
audit.why: Solar Snare is 11s at rank 1 and 1000 range. Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1 dropping to 26s, which makes it roughly one save per wave in the early game — the number that decides when to commit. Golden Eclipse is 120s at rank 1. Radiant Volley is 10s at rank 1 and 950 range.
audit.corrected: Put 11s/1000, 38s and 120s into cooldowns and the prose.

audit.whatIsWrong: Searing Brilliance's Overwhelm mechanic is never explained, so the page cannot tell the player why walking away at low health is dangerous against Mel specifically.
audit.why: Every ability and attack Mel lands applies Overwhelm, the stacks are unlimited, and they can consume themselves to execute. Golden Eclipse then strikes every marked target at any distance — Riot's own range field is 25000, i.e. the whole map. A Cho'Gath who recalls at 20% with stacks on him can die walking to the fountain.
audit.corrected: Say Golden Eclipse reaches anywhere on the map and cashes Overwhelm stacks.

edits.after: Mel's window — Radiant Volley reaches 950, exactly as far as Rupture, but hers lands instantly and yours is a telegraphed delay.

edits.before: Her threat window — full-AP Mel kites your slow frame from max range and times her R to bounce a committed Rupture-burst back at you if the game runs long.
edits.after: Her threat window — full-AP Mel kites your slow frame from 950, and Golden Eclipse strikes every Overwhelm stack on you from anywhere on the map.

edits.before: Mel outranges you hard at levels 1-3 — her Q pokes you from outside Rupture's cast range, so you have to walk into her just to threaten your knockup, and Carnivore alone barely offsets the chip this early. Don't throw Rupture on cooldown for poke; it's a slow, telegraphed skillshot, so save it as a trade-starter or to punish her stepping up to last-hit. Sit at the back of the wave, let Carnivore top you off on minion kills, and respect that if you do commit, her R can reflect the burst right back. Never all-in here.
edits.after: Mel takes levels 1-3, but not on range — Radiant Volley reaches 950 and so does Rupture. Hers lands instantly while yours is a telegraphed circle she walks out of, and Carnivore barely offsets the chip this early. Don't throw Rupture on cooldown for poke; save it as a trade-starter or to punish her stepping up to last-hit. Sit at the back of the wave, let Carnivore top you off, and respect Rebuttal (W): 38s at rank 1, and it stops her taking damage at all. Never all-in into it.

edits.before: This is where the lane levels out. Carnivore sustain, Vorpal Spikes' %-max-HP waveclear, and your Rupture-into-Feral-Scream combo stabilize you around level 4, so you can shove and out-heal her Q poke. At 6, Feast is your spike: a flat true-damage execute that ignores her MR, so if she's already chunked from a landed Q-W and stands in your knockup, the silence from Feral Scream blanks her R and you snap her below the execute threshold. Bait her R out first — once it's down, Q into W locks her for the all-in.
edits.after: This is where the lane levels out. Carnivore sustain, Vorpal Spikes waveclear and your Rupture-into-Feral-Scream combo stabilize you around level 4, so you can shove and out-heal Radiant Volley. At 6, Feast is your spike: flat true damage at 175 range that ignores every point of MR she owns. The one thing that blanks it is Rebuttal — 38s at rank 1, and it prevents her taking damage outright — so bait that first. Once it is down, Q into W locks her for the all-in.

edits.before: Your first item is the best window: Feast stacks plus tank components and Carnivore let you eat her Q all day and win any extended trade where she's caught in Rupture-Scream range. But if the game drags, full-AP Mel reclaims it — she kites your slow, immobile frame from max range, chips you with E, zones the wave with W, and can time her R to bounce a committed Rupture-burst back at you. Force fights mid-game while your Feast spike is ahead of her item scaling, and lean on a teammate to threaten her so she can't free-cast Q.
edits.after: Your first item is the best window: Feast stacks plus tank components and Carnivore let you eat Radiant Volley all day and win any extended trade where she is caught inside Feral Scream's 300-range cone. But if the game drags, full-AP Mel reclaims it — she kites your immobile frame from 950, roots you with Solar Snare at 1000, and Golden Eclipse cashes your Overwhelm stacks from anywhere on the map. Force fights mid-game while your Feast spike still leads her item scaling.

notes: MIRROR: audits/top/mel__chogath.json independently established that Radiant Volley and Rupture both reach 950 and that Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1; I reused both rather than re-deriving them, and my side now states the same facts from Cho'Gath's perspective. The mirror made no level-chart edits, so the flip proposed here should not conflict with it. I also dropped one unverifiable detail while rewriting: the mid paragraph called Vorpal Spikes '%-max-HP waveclear', which is not in champ-data/_kits/chogath.json (Riot's text says only damage and a slow), so I removed the percent claim instead of repeating it. Note the packet defect line 'never names any of Mel's abilities' is only half true — the full layer names Solar Snare correctly throughout; it is the reflect that was misattributed to the wrong slot.
